sources.name: HM Land Registry — England and Wales browser ground
sources.scope: England and Wales HM Land Registry INSPIRE freehold title-index coverage. Application ground is a deterministic derived surface, not a legal title boundary; qualification evidence is bounded at each listed WUP city locator.

sources.licenceNote: Official INSPIRE freehold index downloads are published under the Open Government Licence. Derived ground retains publisher attribution and source provenance.
caveats: Requires a complete, SHA-verified static routing manifest before city bindings are enabled.
Council ZIPs are downloaded and processed in the browser; a transport relay handles the publisher cookie/redirect flow.
Application footprints use deterministic overlap resolution and remain indicative freehold title-index derivatives.
